projects.title: Project SHIELD
projects.summary: An on-device sensor-health intelligence framework that detects degradation and predicts failures from raw sensor signals—built for reliable, self-diagnosing embedded systems.

sections.heading: Focus
sections.body: Universal, on-device sensor health intelligence for early degradation detection and failure prediction.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.body: Physics-informed residual modeling paired with compact TinyML forecasting on MCU-class hardware.

projects.title: Vibration Monitoring for Driver Comfort Analysis
projects.imageAlt: Vibration measurement device testing on a driver seat
projects.summary: A vibration measurement system co-developed for a BAJA SAE team to assess and improve driver comfort.

gallery.caption: Device testing on the pilot seat

sections.heading: System design
sections.body: An ADXL345 accelerometer communicated over I2C and was mounted on the driver seat following ISO 2631-1. An Arduino Uno handled data acquisition, an SD-card module stored data over SPI, and the system plotted and analyzed RMS vibration.

sections.heading: Testing & results
sections.body: The team compared three suspension configurations, evaluated exposure against ISO-5439 limits, and identified 55 psi rear and 45 psi front suspension pressures as the optimal setup.

projects.title: Raijin — High Voltage Electric Drive & Cage Development
projects.summary: R&D work with UW E-Truck Engineering on a custom cage and a 650 V electric-drive system.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.body: Develop a custom cage with a 650 V electric-drive system capable of controlling a high-voltage motor through embedded motor-control algorithms and interlock systems.

sections.heading: Current work
sections.body: Designed a low-voltage interlock circuit with voltage/current trip detection, developed a fan-tachometer signal-processing circuit, and prototyped with regulators, comparators, transducers, timer ICs, and passive components. Verified interlock switching with an oscilloscope.

projects.title: Smart Waste Management Conveyor Belt
projects.imageAlt: SolidWorks model of a smart recycling conveyor
projects.summary: A proof-of-concept smart recycling conveyor informed by a study of waste-management challenges in the Parque da Cidade favela community.

gallery.alt: SolidWorks model of the final conveyor concept
gallery.caption: End-product model

sections.heading: System components
sections.body: Arduino Mega 2560 R3, an ultrasonic distance sensor, LEDs, a motor-driven conveyor, relays, and an external power supply.

sections.heading: Research & outcomes
sections.body: Co-authored a 15-page study, designed a conveyor intended to sort items by material, and built a proof of concept. The sorting system could not be completed because of funding limitations. The project was named Most Outstanding Student in the class; Nicolas led circuitry, coding, and 3D modeling.

projects.title: Car Stand CAD Design for BAJA SAE
projects.summary: A manufacturing-ready car-stand redesign to stop damage to the vehicle cage and improve stability.

gallery.alt: First SolidWorks version of the car stand
gallery.caption: First SolidWorks version

gallery.alt: Technical drawing of final car stand

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The existing stand did not fit the car correctly and was damaging its cage.

sections.heading: Design work
sections.body: Modeled three structural stand versions in SolidWorks, produced manufacturing-ready technical drawings, contributed to tube-width and layout decisions for stability and weight, and collaborated with a teammate performing Ansys structural analysis.

projects.title: Comanda.IA — an AI Chatbot for Restaurants
projects.summary: Two AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot systems for restaurant order management, real-time tracking, and analytics—handling more than 100 daily customer interactions.

sections.heading: System architecture
sections.body: FastAPI for WhatsApp integration; a Chainlit backend; JSON, Google Drive API, and pandas for data management; a Streamlit admin dashboard; and Pytest for AI-response testing.

sections.heading: Key features
sections.body: Natural-language order and customer-data registration, delivery-time estimation through the Google Maps Routes API, SQL-query generation for analytics, and automated broadcast messages.

projects.title: Energy Consumption Growth in the “AI Era”
projects.summary: An exploratory data analysis of U.S. energy-consumption trends following the AI data-center boom.

sections.heading: Dataset
sections.body: Multiple U.S. Energy Information Administration consumption, outlook, and price reports.

sections.heading: Result
sections.body: Identified an increase of more than 2 quadrillion BTU in projected computing-energy consumption in 2050 between the 2019 and 2024 outlooks.

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: Cleaned, normalized, and categorized historical and projected consumption and price data; compared 2019 and 2025 EIA outlooks; corrected historical energy-price data for inflation; and built a visualization pipeline with pandas and seaborn.
